critical_context: VAT GDM and VAT delivery are two tasks from one cohort

statistical_methods.point: Equal-weight task macro, with contexts first averaged per task
statistical_methods.primary_sensitivity_ci: 100,000 replicate 7-source cluster bootstrap; preserve VAT pair
statistical_methods.primary_sensitivity_p: exact 2^7 cohort sign-flips, two-sided under symmetric exchangeability null
statistical_methods.context_conditional_ci: 30,000 paired resamples within 34 task-context cells; NOT independent test patients
statistical_methods.multiple_testing: Holm and Benjamini-Hochberg over 12 comparator contrasts per metric
statistical_methods.model_selection: three-expert proposal motivated by already-seen benchmark; p values not confirmatory
